outline: This course is to introduce elementary topics about Crystallography in materials science.
schedule:
1. Crystal
2. Bravais lattice
3. Diffraction and selection rule
4. Symmetry operation
5. Point group
6. Structure determination
7. Other related topics
materials:
(Optional)
Elements of X-ray Diffraction, B. D. Cullity and S. R. Stock
Essentials of Crystallography, Duncan McKie and Christine McKie
Crystallography - An Introduction, Walter Borchardt-Ott
